continuity_scope: Pass limited to R. F. Kuang's The Poppy War, Harper Voyager first edition ISBN 9780062662569, Book One only. Excludes The Dragon Republic, The Burning God, related material, author commentary, and any adaptation possibility.
coverage_rule: Nine named individual dramatic characters in the first novel. Ethnic/cultural analogues, schools, military units, gods, drugs, places, and historical allusions remain dimensions or terms, not relationship endpoints.
omissions: Books Two and Three, companion/author material, and all adaptations.
Collective/institutional nodes, ethnic peoples, gods, places, drugs, and historical entities.
uncertainties: Nikan, the Federation, Speer, and the war are fictional constructs; historical inspiration does not create one-to-one equivalence with Chinese, Japanese, or any other history.
Chapter locators are used because printing pagination varies.
The novel depicts colonialism, structural prejudice, war, genocide/atrocity, torture, addiction, and sexual violence.
evidence_basis: Primary claims use the declared Harper Voyager printed witness and chapter loci; Harper and the author's official site establish edition/author context.
